title: content-refresh-sop.playbook-step template variables
description: Values for templates/content-refresh-sop.playbook-step.md.j2 and templates/content-refresh-sop.playbook-step.html.j2. Generated by tpl-jinja from content-refresh-sop.playbook-step.md; `description` on each property is the question put to the author.

cycle_date.title: Cycle date
cycle_date.description: Date the refresh cycle is scored, YYYY-MM-DD. From the title.

impressions_trend_pct.title: Impressions trend pct
impressions_trend_pct.description: Negative percentage change in impressions below which a URL is a refresh candidate, e.g. -20. From section 'Thresholds'.

intent_shift_query_mix_pct.title: Intent shift query mix pct
intent_shift_query_mix_pct.description: Percentage change in query mix above which the intent has shifted, e.g. 30. From section 'Thresholds'.

position_decay_positions.title: Position decay positions
position_decay_positions.description: Positions of average-position loss above which a URL is a refresh candidate, e.g. 2. From section 'Thresholds'.

site_domain.title: Site domain
site_domain.description: Domain of the content inventory being scored. From the title.

trailing_days.title: Trailing days
trailing_days.description: Length in days of the trailing window and of the equal prior window, e.g. 90. From section 'Window'.
